title: Read distributions and states over time

blocks.content: Practice reading distributions and states over time. Start with "How many values fall between 0 and 100, between 100 and 200, and so on?" Read a histogram, then a heatmap to add time. For "What state has something been in, and when did it change?", compare a state timeline with status history.
Use demo dashboards on Grafana Play. Keep the histogram and heatmap dashboards open in full-dashboard view: their examples reuse data from another panel. You don't need to edit or save anything.
